_about: Planner-side metadata for routine-tasks.json (fields not in the RoutineTask contract; see NOTES.md). `value` (1-5) is a planner judgement built from the sourced yields in valueReason, not a game number.

_estimates.label: ESTIMATE - pending T0
_estimates.basis: planner-estimate-v0: no source anywhere publishes minutes per task (A10-0002, gap L-A10-01). Every estimatedMinutes value is a placeholder chosen by the planner author to order tasks, to be replaced by the T0 stopwatch (research/protocolos/t0-medicao.md section 3).

vip-claim.valueReason: VIP points 40 -> 200/day with a streak; one missed day costs up to 720 VIP points over the next 8 days (A05-0003). Chest grows with VIP level (A05-0006).

daily-ap-claim.valueReason: 500 AP per daily claim (T1 1.0.41, 2026 amount unverified: L-A09-02) (A09-0006).
daily-ap-claim.mustDoReason: Always claim daily AP (daily-routine recommendations; A09-0006).

daily-objectives-100.valueReason: 100-point chest = 100 gems (only guaranteed daily gem source) + Golden Key + 3 epic sculptures; chests give 170 min of speedups/day (derived) (A04-0001, A04-0010). Task list partly outdated since 1.1.09 (A10-0001).
daily-objectives-100.mustDoReason: Only guaranteed daily gem income for F2P (A04-0001).

queues.valueReason: Idle builder/research/training queues lose account progress; building 10 + research 5 + training 5 Daily Objective points (A10-0001); dashboard from CH8 (A01-0011).
queues.mustDoReason: Keep both builders working (A10-0002, consensus 'minimise logins, maximise uptime').

gathering.valueReason: +25% gathering speed in alliance territory (A03-0009); big nodes before logging off so marches do not return early (A03-0016); 5 Daily Objective points per resource type (A10-0001).

alliance-help.valueReason: 20 helps = 10 Daily Objective points; each help received fills 1% of the bar (A10-0006).

ap-spend.valueReason: AP caps at 1,500 so unspent regeneration is wasted (A09-0001); barbarians give EXP, resources, speedups (A09-0002); auto-peacekeeping exists (A09-0008).

city-collect.valueReason: Farm/lumber storage = 10x hourly output, production stops after ~10 h if not collected (A03-0002).

tavern-chests.valueReason: 3 -> 10 free silver chests/day by Tavern level: tomes, speedups, rare sculptures (A10-0003).

alliance-donate.valueReason: New Daily Objective task since 1.1.09 (points unknown, L-A10-02) (A10-0001, C04-0004).

courier-merchant.valueReason: 1 free refresh/24h; buy speedups with resources; 10 purchases = 10 Daily Objective points (A04-0011, A10-0001).

expedition-claim.valueReason: Daily claim of all 3-star missions; medals buy sculptures (1,500 per legendary); medals/day unknown (A10-0004).

sunset-canyon.valueReason: Daily attempts give seasonal speedup rewards even when losing; top 5 -> Golden Key (A10-0008).

lyceum-mock.valueReason: Mock exam gives Flashes of Insight only; does not affect qualification (A10-0005).

vip-shop-weekly.valueReason: 30x 100 AP for food (VIP2) + 50x 5-min speedups for food (VIP3) = 3,000 AP + 250 min/week without gems (A04-0007, A09-0006).

peerless-exam.valueReason: Passing the Preliminary or Final splits a gem pool (size unknown, L-A04-05) (A10-0005).

events.valueReason: Event schedule is not fixed; plan from the in-game calendar (A11-0512); hoard AP items for Lohar / Eve of the Crusade (A09-0007).

breakModeNotes.text: Account protection while away (shield, troops, resources) has NO fact card yet; S-D-0002 Idea 2 premise P1 is unverified. Do not rely on this planner for safety while paused.
Before pausing, start the longest builds/research and send gatherers to the largest nodes so marches do not return early.
